plugins.name: multi-account
plugins.description: Connect your own Claude accounts one at a time and run one task on all of them at once: one git worktree per piece, handed to another account when one hits its limit, joined at the end; accounts can have roles (plan, design, dev, audit)

plugins.name: multi-account-pane
plugins.description: A pane beside the chat for the multi-account plugin; start a message with all: to split it across your accounts, or with an account name to send it to that one
